notes:
REF-BM-02: Saving performs no remote metadata collection.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable before and after saving, but description and auto-collected metadata are absent.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, and one topic are editable; description, multiple tags, and note are absent.
REF-BM-07: Rows expose title and topic grouping, but no description, per-item tags, or favicon.
REF-BM-09: A bookmark supports only one topic rather than one or more tags.
REF-BM-10: No tag autocomplete is implemented.
REF-BM-12: Case-insensitive search covers title and URL (plus topic), but not description or note.
REF-BM-14: No #tag search syntax is parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are not supported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is not supported.
REF-BM-17: Bookmarks have no unread state.
REF-BM-18: There is no unread-only view.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk action support.
REF-BM-21: No action can target the whole filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: There is no user-selectable sorting by key.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not created.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived.
REF-BM-27: No reversible archive operation exists distinct from deletion.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-only list.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
